content: {"like":["Prefers classic sci‑fi anthology series with iconic episodes (e.g., Twilight Zone Season 5).","Values action‑adventure family films with catchy music and character secrets (e.g., Elena & Avalor).","Enjoys complete, in‑order releases of older sitcoms (e.g., What I Like About You Season 2).","Appreciates faithful animated retellings of film franchises (e.g., The Mummy Animated Series).","Favors comprehensive box sets that include all films and special features (e.g., Terminator Anthology)."],"dislike":["Dislikes filler or unnecessary episodes that drag a series (e.g., Hannah Montana Season 4).","Avoids content that spoils plot before viewing (e.g., Terminator Genisys trailer).","Rejects retooled or out‑of‑order releases that confuse continuity (e.g., Elena movie aired as episode).","Dislikes missing or incomplete special features in releases (e.g., Disney Parks Blu‑ray).","Prefers not to watch films split into unrelated segments (e.g., Left Behind adaptation)."]}
